## How to sign

On your first pull request, a bot asks you to sign. Post this exact comment on
the pull request:

```
I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA
```

The bot records your GitHub username, the time and the pull request number in
`signatures/version1/cla.json` on the repository's `cla-signatures` branch. You
sign once; later pull requests are covered.
